name: RC-B10-0173/2024 – § 4 – Am 15
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the Council’s recommendation on smoke- and aerosol-free environments
part_text: 4. Underlines that smoke-free environments protect the health of both non-smokers and smokers, as they prevent non-smokers from exposure and encourage smokers to reduce their consumption or stop smoking completely; furthermore recalls the need for policies to stick to the principle of harm reduction and recalls that new and emerging products may allow smokers to progressively quit smoking, as recognised in its previous resolutions on smoke-free environments and on non-communicable diseases; highlights that harm reduction policies should be based on scientific evidence and proportionality, as this improves their acceptance by citizens;
